label: Dawn Haze #12
evidence: Tall form has many usable branches and an even top, with only mild lower spacing gaps.
Visible gland coverage is high and consistent.
Aroma is lemon, floral, and soft pine with very good repeatability across notes.
Output is above the deck median but outside the top three.
Pale green and cream presentation is very uniform, with moderate contrast.
The grower kept dated photos, labels, comparisons, and a complete end-of-run summary.
When lower growth slowed, the grower reviewed prior images, made one small change, and recorded both a short-term and later comparison.

notes.structure: Many useful branches and an even top justify a high score.
notes.resin: High, consistent visible coverage scores strongly.
notes.terps: Clear multi-note identity repeats well across observations.
notes.yield: The fictional output is above median but not top-three.
notes.color: Uniformity is excellent; contrast is moderate.
notes.documentation: The record is complete and easy to trace.
notes.problem-solving: Historical comparison, a limited change, and two follow-ups make the reasoning strong.

label: Grape Static #33
evidence: Compact structure is extremely even and supported, but has fewer total branches than the broadest entries.
Visible gland coverage is dense, bright, and consistent across the card.
Aroma notes show grape, floral, and fuel, though the fuel note disappears in one observation.
Recorded output is right around the fictional deck median.
Ruby-purple accents are vivid and highly consistent.
Documentation includes complete labels and photos but no written comparison between early and final structure.
An early weak branch was tracked in photos and later removed from selection consideration, with the reason recorded clearly.

notes.structure: Excellent balance and support outweigh a lower total branch count.
notes.resin: Coverage is benchmark-level in the fictional deck.
notes.terps: Complexity is good, with one inconsistency between observations.
notes.yield: The record sits around the deck median.
notes.color: Vivid, consistent contrast earns a top mark.
notes.documentation: Traceability is good, but a comparative structure summary is missing.
notes.problem-solving: The weak branch was tracked and the final decision was documented with a clear reason.
